item.title: Divine Word University prepares for 2026 student registration and celebrates 30 years of service
item.description: Staff of Divine Word University (DWU) have completed two weeks of resumption activities in preparation for student registration for the 2026 academic year. Registration will commence on 2 February and conclude on 13 February 2026 across all DWU campuses. The University Registrar has indicated that enrolment numbers are expected to reach 2,030 students at the Madang campus, 625 in Wewak, 573 in Rabaul, and 133 in Port Moresby. item.title: Cooper Bai cleared of serious injury after road accident
item.description: Papua New Guinean international rugby League prospect and Gold Coast Titans rookie Cooper Bai has avoided serious injury following a car accident earlier this week. The 19-year-old, who is the son of Kumuls and Melbourne Storm legend Marcus Bai, was involved in a collision while traveling to the Titans' Parkwood headquarters for training. item.title: Cabinet greenlights USD$120 Million ‘Pukpuk Connectivity Initiative’
item.description: The National Executive Council (NEC) has officially approved a landmark USD $120 million digital infrastructure package destined to transform Papua New Guinea’s international connectivity through the "Pukpuk Connectivity Initiative." The proposal, backed by the Australian Infrastructure Financing Facility for the Pacific (AIFFP), will deliver three new international submarine cable connections to the country. item.title: Bougainville Government declines BCL equity dilution proposal
item.description: The President of the Autonomous Bougainville Government (ABG), Ishmael Toroama, has confirmed that the ABG has rejected the proposed partnership between Bougainville Copper Limited (BCL) and CMOC Group Limited in relation to the Panguna project. This decision follows careful consideration and reflects the ABG’s position as the majorityshareholder with a combined 72.9 per cent ownership in BCL. item.title: SVD celebrates 150 years of service.
item.description: The Society of the Divine Word (SVD) celebrated 150 years of serving the world, 130 years in Papua New Guinea, and 92 years in Simbu. The festivities, held from January 26th to 29th January, 2026 at Mingende Catholic Mission brought together SVD priests from across PNG, dignitaries, and members of the community. item.description: The Sustainable Development Program (SDP) has announced a targeted investment to strengthen primary and preventative healthcare across rural and remote communities in the South Fly and Delta Fly Districts. The initiative places the emphasis squarely on improving health outcomes for families, supporting local health workers, and supporting provincial health priorities. item.title: New state house, water system, roads and Gaubin Health upgrades opened in Sumkar
item.description: Major government projects have been officially opened in Sumkar District. They include a new district state house, an upgraded water supply, the refurbished district headquarters, new road machinery, and improvements at Gaubin Health Centre on Karkar Island. The launch coincided with the release of the district’s Five-Year Development Plan.
